params.body:
## What

`bin/findings-to-issues --apply` mirrored the open findings of severity `nu` (#570 to #572) and `deze week` (#574 to #614) as issues, through the gateway (`issue.open`, control v0.28.1, one record each). This writes the numbers back into the files, so the repository and GitHub say the same thing; the file stays the source.

44 findings in total. What is left unmirrored is severity `later` (44 more); `bin/findings-to-issues` without arguments says what it would open.

## Worth knowing

Opening the first three took three attempts, and each failure was a missing link rather than a bug in the mirror: the kind was not yet in the grant the VM carried, then the adapter did not claim the kind it answered (fixed and guarded in abovebeyond-ai/control#87), then the GitHub App lacked `Issues: read and write`, which an organisation accepts per installation, the same dance as the Workflows permission on 16 September.
params.title: The findings of severity nu and deze week carry their issue (replaces #573)
